apiKey.description: PromptLayer API key. Falls back to PROMPTLAYER_API_KEY env var.

serviceName.description: OTEL service name for resource identification.

providerName.description: Default GenAI provider name, e.g. openai or anthropic.

providerNameMap.description: Map OpenClaw provider ids to OTEL provider names.

captureToolInput.description: Record tool call arguments as span attributes.

captureToolOutput.description: Record tool results as span attributes.

toolInputMaxLength.description: Max character length for captured tool input.

toolOutputMaxLength.description: Max character length for captured tool output.

captureMessageContent.description: Record GenAI request and response messages on chat spans.

captureHistoryMessages.description: Include available conversation history in captured GenAI input messages.

historyMessagesMaxLength.description: Max character length for serialized message arrays stored on spans.

redactSecrets.description: Strip API keys, tokens, JWTs, passwords, and similar secrets from captured data.

spanProcessorType.description: Span processor type. Use simple for exporter debugging.
